title: Cartridge capability descriptor
description: Machine-readable metadata a host routes on to select among cartridges, per the cartridge contract (index.adoc 'Anatomy of a cartridge'). Describes what a cartridge IS and MEASURES, not what it promises. v0.2: adds spec_version, family, model, quality (mandatory for task=asr), performance.methodology, attributes.endpointing, requirements.os; removes fallback_of (ADR-006 — fallback is resolved, not declared). v0.3: adds flavors (ADR-014) — additional measured variants (language, runtime tier, ABI) sharing one descriptor's task/family/io/license identity.

spec_version.description: The cartridge-spec version this descriptor conforms to. The descriptor shape is unchanged between 0.3 and 0.4 (v0.4 adds blueprints and optional manifest provenance), so both are valid.

execution_mode.description: 'native' = HW-compiled/optimized for `target` (a vendor NPU compiler, ORT with the ABI's kernels, IREE). 'eager' = portable reference implementation — the universal fallback tier, contract-compliant by design (v0.2 contract, 'fastest path for its declared execution_mode').

family.description: Model-family identity — the binary-plane grouping (ADR-006). Same family + same io contract = package-swappable; also scopes weight-update applicability. NOT a fallback declaration: fallback is resolved by the host from task + required attributes + tier preference.

version.description: Cartridge build version. Semver recommended; a swap must be auditable (OQ3).

model.description: Provenance of the model this cartridge runs — where the weights descend from and under what terms (ADR-004). The manifest carries digests; this carries identity.

variant.description: Build-specific variant: quantization, window, language set.

checkpoint.description: The upstream checkpoint the weights derive from.

source.description: URL or identifier of the upstream model source.

license.description: The upstream model's license (SPDX where possible). The cartridge's effective `license` must fulfill this (ADR-004).

The cartridge's EFFECTIVE license (ADR-004): must be satisfiable given every per-artifact upstream license recorded in the manifest. An SPDX identifier means open and redistributable; 'proprietary' or a license/entitlement URL means gated (pair with an `encryption` block on the weights artifact); 'NOASSERTION' marks a not-yet-remediated package and is treated as a FAILURE by conformance tooling, by design.

task.description: Open vocabulary — extend as new cartridge types appear.

io.description: Input/output contract, in tensor or stream terms — not application terms. Same io + same family = binary-plane swappable (ADR-006).

target.description: Hardware + ABI this cartridge runs on. A cartridge is built for exactly one target; a different target is a different cartridge instance.

accelerator.description: NPU/GPU identifier when hardware is accelerator-backed, else omit.

performance.description: Measured on the stated target, reported honestly — including when it is not good enough. Never a promise or a spec-sheet number.

rtf.description: Real-time factor (processing time / audio duration). Lower is faster; <1 is faster than real time.

measured_on.description: What device/board/run this number came from, so it's falsifiable. Keep internal infrastructure details (device IPs, hostnames) OUT of public descriptors.

methodology.description: Pointer (path or URL) to the workload/benchmark definition that produced these numbers — audio set, durations, device state — so the number is reproducible, not just asserted.

quality.description: Task-level quality, measured — the metric a swap or fallback decision actually needs (parity-within-tolerance does NOT measure task quality). MANDATORY for task=asr: either a measured wer, or an explicit unmeasured=true with the harness that will produce it — never silently absent.

wer.description: Word error rate on the stated dataset (asr).

dataset_digest.description: Digest of the evaluation set, so the number is pinned to exact data.

harness.description: The tool/harness that produced (or will produce) the metric.

unmeasured.description: Explicit marker that quality has not been measured yet. Conformance tooling flags it; policy decides whether that blocks.

attributes.description: Task-specific properties a host may use as hard constraints or soft preferences. Open vocabulary by design.

endpointing.description: What endpointing machinery is INSIDE the cartridge (ADR-003): 'none' = host-driven stop only; 'signal' = VAD/segmentation inside, surfaced as data events (e.g. CTG_RESULT_ENDPOINT); 'semantic' = model-level end-of-utterance signals. Acting on any of them is host policy.

requirements.description: What a host must satisfy to run this cartridge, split by WHERE it is checkable: abi/os/packaging at build time; driver/memory/accelerator presence at runtime via ctg_preflight (abi.adoc) — a build machine cannot see fleet state.

note.description: Human-readable constraint detail, e.g. why a patched build is required.
examples: stock vendor driver miscompiles int8 output on AArch32; patched >=1.7.1 required

flavors.description: Per ADR-014: additional variants of this same package — another bundled language, another runtime tier, another ABI — that differ from the base descriptor above in attributes/model/performance/quality/target/requirements. The base descriptor's own fields ARE the default flavor, unchanged; a host that does not understand `flavors` still resolves correctly against them. Each flavor is independently addressable (own `id`) and independently measured, subject to every rule that applies to the base descriptor (`quality` mandatory for task=asr on every flavor too — enforced by ctg-conform, not expressible as a schema conditional from inside an array item, since it needs the root `task`). A flavor field, when present, REPLACES the base descriptor's field of the same name in full for that flavor — no deep merge; repeat unchanged sub-fields rather than relying on inference. `spec_version`/`id`(base)/`version`/`family`/`execution_mode`/`license`/`modality`/`task`/`io` are never flavor-overridable — they define what makes this the same cartridge (ADR-006's binary-plane identity); a flavor that needs one of those to differ is a different cartridge, not a flavor.

id.description: Distinct from the base descriptor's `id` and every other flavor's `id`.

shape.description: Tensor shape; use null for a streaming/variable dimension.

chunk_ms.description: For streaming ports: the unit the cartridge consumes/emits per call.

output_schema.description: Per ADR-007: a JSON-Schema fragment — inline, or a digest/pointer to one — describing the shape of a structured output port (e.g. a tool-call result: name + typed arguments), for ports whose output is a parsed, typed result rather than raw tensors or free text.
